changeSet.author: campaign-platform
changeSet.comment: Create campaign_channel join table linking campaigns to their channels with budget allocation
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE public.campaign_channel ( id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, channel_id BIGINT NOT NULL, allocation_percent NUMERIC(5,2), budget_allocated NUMERIC(15,2), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT pk_campaign_channel PRIMARY KEY (id),
CONSTRAINT uk_campaign_channel UNIQUE (campaign_id, channel_id),
CONSTRAINT fk_campaign_channel_campaign FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES public.campaign(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT fk_campaign_channel_channel FOREIGN KEY (channel_id) REFERENCES public.channel(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT );
